## Stuck Diagnostic

`When you are stuck, identify which layer the confusion lives in before asking for help.`

[ ] I don't understand the problem this solves
    → Build the version without it. Ship the naive implementation. Feel the pain.

[ ] I understand the problem but not the solution
    → Draw the data flow on paper before touching the keyboard.

[ ] I understand the solution but not when to apply it
    → List 3 scenarios where it helps. List 2 where it makes things worse.

[ ] I understand it conceptually but can't implement it
    → Implement the smallest possible version from scratch, no references, no docs.

[ ] I can implement it but can't explain why it's correct
    → Write the explanation in plain English. If you can't, you don't understand it yet.
